audit_title: Estimator-Aware Value of Information (VOI) Model Training Data Sufficiency Audit
scientific_integrity_enforcement: Because development sequences (N=3 < 5) and paired intervention outcomes (N=14 < 30) fall below the empirical sufficiency threshold, fitting a parameterized regression/classification model would result in severe over-fitting and pseudo-calibration. In accordance with Phase 5 rules, R7 is officially designated as an exploratory priority proxy (R7_ESTIMATOR_AWARE_PRIORITY_PROXY). No synthetic targets or fabricated calibration coefficients are permitted.
required_additional_data_for_full_voi: At least 2 additional independent TUM RGB-D sequences with verified object tracks and MoCap (e.g. fr2_desk, fr3_sitting).
At least 1 additional OpenLORIS sequence with distinct pedestrian motion.
At least 16 additional candidate-level paired intervention runs to reach N=30.
